next_step: Finalize POC SLA matrix for streaming + per-tenant quotas; pricing review w/ finance (wk of 2026-03-10).
notes: 2026-02-10 call w/ CTO + Head of Product — demo recap. Liked streaming latency and API ergonomics. ‘Need consistent streaming, tool calls can’t drop’ (quote from CTO).
POC scope: start w/ Hosted API for 6-week functional POC -> evaluate Dedicated for predictable throughput if SLOs hold. Focus: multi-tenant agent product for SMB/SME customers.
Primary ask: per-tenant rate/quotas (requests/min and token caps), token-level cost visibility by tenant, burst controls. They will bill tenants and need strict accounting.
Latency SLO: target p50 < 80ms for incremental tokens, p95 < 200ms end-to-end for streaming (current target p95 150-180ms). Will test under 50/100 concurrent sessions per tenant.
Tool calling: customer has chain-of-tools for CRM lookups and payments. Concern: streaming + tool call hop introduces jitter. Need deterministic retry behavior and idempotency guidance.

Security: require SSO/SAML, audit logs forwarded to their ELK, KMS integration for model request metadata encryption, EU data residency for euro customers. Passed initial SOC2 questionnaire but need formal security FAQ (attached).
Cost sensitivity: mid-market price elasticity; prefer hosted for dev but want Dedicated reserved capacity if costs predictable. Interested in Optimize suggestions (batching, quant profiles).
Quote from Head of Product: 'If streaming is rock-solid and we can enforce per-tenant quotas cleanly, we can justify moving to dedicated for peak customers.'
Risks: burst pricing during Black Friday-type events; multi-tenant noisy neighbor behavior; missed SLAs -> revenue leakage to customers (SLA credits).
Internal stakeholders: CTO (Ayesha Khan), Head of Product (Marco Silva), Platform Eng lead (Jules Park), Security (Rafael Ortega).
